import pandas as pd

# Read the files
quotes = pd.read_csv('quotes.csv')
actions = pd.read_csv('corporate_actions.csv')

# Convert dates to datetime
quotes['date'] = pd.to_datetime(quotes['date'])
actions['date'] = pd.to_datetime(actions['date'])

# Merge quotes and actions on date and ticker
merged_data = pd.merge(quotes, actions, on=['date', 'ticker'], how='left')

# Handle splits
split_adjustments = merged_data[merged_data['kind'] == 'SPLIT']
split_adjustments['value'] = 1 / split_adjustments['value']

# Apply split adjustments
for index, row in split_adjustments.iterrows():
    mask = (merged_data['date'] >= row['date']) & (merged_data['ticker'] == row['ticker'])
    merged_data.loc[mask, 'close'] *= row['value']

# Handle dividends
dividend_adjustments = merged_data[merged_data['kind'] == 'DIVIDEND']
dividend_adjustments['value'] = 1 - dividend_adjustments['value']

# Apply dividend adjustments
for index, row in dividend_adjustments.iterrows():
    mask = (merged_data['date'] >= row['date']) & (merged_data['ticker'] == row['ticker'])
    merged_data.loc[mask, 'close'] *= row['value']

# Drop unnecessary columns
adjusted_quotes = merged_data.drop(columns=['kind', 'value', 'note'])

# Save the adjusted quotes to a new CSV file
